metadata.method: word-boundary regex of normalized node labels (+ aliases) vs question+options text. Stop-list filters generic single-word labels.
metadata.threshold_rationale: Per-era threshold chosen so that the anchor-deserving set lands in [20,50] nodes (target = ~10-15 short stories × ~3 anchors). Where the pool is too small (prehistoric, ancient-indus, early-medieval) the threshold defaults to ≥1 and the full PYQ-matched set becomes the anchor pool. Threshold is a proposal — Task 2 (bundling) may push back based on what coheres as a short story.
